item.title: Transparent Moon Bakery Logo

turns.text: Make a square logo for my bakery, Mooncrumb: a gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering. Send it as a transparent PNG so I can put it on different backgrounds. No white box behind it.

item.tests: Delivers a new logo with genuine background transparency rather than a white or painted-checkerboard background.

answer_sheet.Design: A gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering.
answer_sheet.File format and background: PNG with actual transparency outside the logo, not a white box or checkerboard drawn into the image.

must_haves: The name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy lettering.
A gold crescent moon is positioned above the name.
When viewed over different colored backgrounds, the surrounding area is transparent with no opaque rectangle or baked-in checkerboard.
The moon and letter edges remain intact, without conspicuous white halos or missing strokes.

turns.text: Make a square logo for my bakery, Mooncrumb: a gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering. Send it as a transparent PNG so I can put it on different backgrounds, with no white box behind it. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
The cheapest practical option is a **640 × 640 square logo**:

| Step | Credits |
|---|---:|
| Generate one logo with a free-plan model, such as Flux Schnell | 5 |
| Remove the background for genuine transparency—not a white box | 5 |
| **Total listed cost** | **10** |

I’d use a gold crescent above dark navy **Mooncrumb** lettering, with a clean, bakery-style design, then deliver a **transparent PNG**.

**Cheaper alternative:** generate the logo for **5 credits**, then remove the background yourself in a free editor. Simply prompting for transparency isn’t a reliable substitute for removing the background.

640px is the smallest listed image setting; “shorter” doesn’t apply to a still logo. **Nothing has run or spent credits.**

Would you like the **10-credit transparent PNG workflow**, or the **5-credit logo-only option**?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the 10-credit transparent PNG workflow.

dialog.agent:
Before spending your credits, I found an important restriction: **Magic Hour requires a paid subscription, a credit-pack purchase, or an agreed paid usage-based arrangement for commercial use.** A bakery logo would be commercial use.

**No credits have been spent.** Have you purchased a credit pack? If so, we can proceed with the approved workflow.

Otherwise, I can write a transparent SVG logo here for **zero Magic Hour credits**, which you can export to PNG in a free editor.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the zero-credit transparent SVG option, which I can export to PNG in a free editor.

turns.agent:
Here’s a **zero-credit SVG** with a gold crescent above dark navy lettering. The background is transparent—there’s no white rectangle.

Save the code below as **`mooncrumb.svg`**:

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     width="512" height="512" viewBox="0 0 512 512"
     role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
  <title id="title">Mooncrumb bakery logo</title>
  <desc id="desc">
    A gold crescent moon above dark navy Mooncrumb lettering,
    on a transparent background.
  </desc>

  <!-- Gold crescent; the open area is genuinely transparent. -->
  <path
    d="M 342,95
       A 118,118 0 1,0 342,305
       A 110,110 0 0,1 342,95 Z"
    fill="#C59B45"/>

  <!-- Bakery wordmark -->
  <text
    x="256" y="397"
    text-anchor="middle"
    font-family="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif"
    font-size="64"
    font-weight="400"
    letter-spacing="-1.5"
    fill="#14233E">Mooncrumb</text>
</svg>
```

**To export a transparent PNG in Inkscape (free):**
1. Open `mooncrumb.svg`.
2. Choose **File → Export**, then select **Page**.
3. Keep the background’s alpha at **0** and export as PNG.

The SVG scales to any size, so you can export at **512 × 512** or larger without pixelating the design. The lettering uses Georgia if installed; convert the text to paths before sharing the SVG if you want to lock in its appearance.

**Magic Hour credits spent: 0.**
